title: A multimodal agent, with delegated generation
summary:
A multimodal agent and delegated generation joined the codebase while Gemini Search routing and Polli’s media handling got attention.

Team work added polli-agent, an OpenAI-compatible router that can stream responses and combine model calls with image, video, audio, search, and media tools. It was also registered as an app. Separately, admin-enabled community agent endpoints gained short-lived run tokens so they can generate against a caller’s model access and budget without receiving the caller’s API key.

Gemini Search models were restored to direct Vertex routing, with native Google Search grounding and usage accounting for streamed responses. Text-provider 429 errors are also reported as upstream failures rather than as rate limits imposed on the caller.

The Discord assistant now uses static thumbnails for GIFV vision input instead of unsupported video inputs. It also gives shorter answers, retrieves less unnecessary context, and uses display names while keeping usernames available for tool calls.

highlights.title: Polli-agent combines media tools
highlights.text: Polli-agent adds an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint that can stream responses and coordinate text, image, video, audio, web search, and media-processing tools in one request.

highlights.title: Delegated agent generation
highlights.text: Enabled community agent endpoints can make generation requests using a short-lived run token tied to the caller’s model access and budget, without receiving the caller’s API key.
